title: 第3章 明白了穿越者的烦恼第4章 女帝转世
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
隔着南疆数亿公里的东荒，一只相当于合道境的白虎王正准备回洞府守着准备开花的白玉莲，之前在南疆扩散过来的气息也把它吓得半死。
原本是杀了一些人类修士，用他们精血让白玉莲的药效更上一层楼的，回到洞府的半路感觉到了那股气息，可那股气息把它附近的妖兽全吓跑了，没跑的也在洞里瑟瑟发抖。
它倒是不担心自己的白玉莲有什么问题毕竟在东荒，除了冥阳宗太上长老能和自己五五开，其他的在它眼里都是蝼蚁。
突然它身后空间破裂，一只手掌向它抓来，它瞬间炸毛，那股气息就是这只手的主人发出来的，哪怕它把吃奶的力气都用在逃命上，还是瞬间被那只手扯着尾巴拖进了空间裂缝，它最后深深的看了一眼这片土地。
青墨把手从空间裂缝抽了回来，还顺带抽出一个大巴车大小的白虎，它双爪抱头缩成个球，差点还以为是只刺猬。
青墨：喂！
小猫咪，我这里有份坐骑的工作，我觉得你还凑合。
我这里包吃包住，待遇丰厚！
白虎王把挡住眼睛的爪子拿开，看到了青墨，“大人，你只是要我当坐骑，不是要杀我？”
“没想到你居然提这个要求，可以今晚宵夜有了”
青墨无所谓的说到。
“坐骑好，坐骑好，我的肉太老不好吃，”
白虎王说到
“大人，冒昧问一句，之前那股气息是您对吗？”
白虎王全身发抖的问到
青墨：是我，怎么你有什么想法？
白虎王：没有，绝对没有能当大人的坐骑，是我几辈子修来的福分！
“行了，别啰嗦了，快到凉城的时候告诉我”
青墨一屁股坐在白虎王的背上。
“公子还有半刻钟不到就到凉城了”

，大白说道，青墨给白虎王取名大白，让它以后称呼自己为公子
路上青墨炼化了老师傅给的令牌，进入了小世界。
青墨：卧槽
系统：卧槽
整整一个星系的星球上，放满了各种各样的天材地宝，各种武器，丹药，神泉，圣水，灵石，神石，仙石矿脉数不胜数。
系统头一次觉得自己的商城那么的寒酸（′???）σ
青墨：老师傅只是说让我看着玩，我知道他的存货很多，但是这也太离谱了吧！
青墨装了亿点点东西在空间戒指里面就出来了。
还扔给了大白一个五百万年份的彩鳞果。
大白开心得差点一口气没上来，抽死过去。
还好青墨本着为自家员工着想的态度，让这方世界的天道给了它两大嘴巴，才清醒过来，并且告诉它给它的彩鳞果是目前年份最低的的了。
一般只是用做肥料。
大白这才知道自家的公子是真的壕无人性啊，自己在这片大陆活了快万年了，都没听说过有超过二十万年以上的药材，哪怕是中州最顶级的那几大宗门有的也不过十七八万年的，而且还把它当做是镇宗之宝。
快到凉城时青墨让大白缩小到一只家猫的大小，别说还挺可爱的。
content_en:
Across the eastern wasteland hundreds of millions of kilometers away in southern Xinjiang, a white tiger king equivalent to the Hedao realm was preparing to return to the cave to guard the white jade lotus that was about to bloom. The aura that had spread in southern Xinjiang scared it half to death.
Originally, he killed some human monks and used their essence and blood to improve the effectiveness of the White Jade Lotus. Halfway back to the cave, he felt the aura, but the aura scared away all the monsters near it. Those who did not escape were also shivering in the cave.
It is not worried about any problems with its White Jade Lotus. After all, in the Eastern Wasteland, except for the Supreme Elder of the Mingyang Sect who can be evenly matched with itself, the others are all ants in its eyes.
Suddenly the space behind it broke apart, and a hand grabbed it. Its fur instantly exploded. That breath was coming from the owner of this hand. Even though it spent all its energy trying to escape, it was still dragged into the space crack by the tail of the hand. It took one last deep look at the land.
Qing Mo pulled his hand back from the crack in space, and also pulled out a white tiger the size of a bus. It held its head with its paws and curled up into a ball. It almost looked like a hedgehog.
Qingmo: Hello!
Little Kitty, I have a mount job here, and I think you’re okay.
My food and accommodation are included here, and the treatment is generous!
The White Tiger King took away the paw that was blocking his eyes and saw Qing Mo, "Sir, you just want me to be your mount, don't you want to kill me?"
"I didn't expect you to make such a request. I can have a late-night snack tonight."
Qing Mo said indifferently.
"Good mount, good mount, my meat is too old to taste,"
The White Tiger King said
"Sir, I would like to ask, was that breath from you before?"
The White Tiger King asked with trembling all over.
Qingmo: It's me, why do you have any ideas?
White Tiger King: No, there is absolutely no mount that can be used as an adult. It is a blessing that I have cultivated for several lifetimes!
"Okay, don't be nagging. Tell me when you get to Liangcheng."
Qing Mo sat down on the White Tiger King's back.
"Young Master will arrive at Liangcheng in less than half a quarter of an hour."
, Dabai said, Qingmo named the White Tiger King Dabai and let him call himself Young Master from now on.
On the way, Qing Mo refined the token given by his master and entered the small world.
Qingmo: Damn!
System: Damn it
The planets in the entire galaxy are filled with all kinds of treasures, weapons, elixirs, divine springs, holy water, spiritual stones, divine stones, and countless fairy stone veins.
For the first time, the system felt that its mall was so shabby (′???)σ
Qing Mo: The old master just said he wanted me to watch and play with it. I know he has a lot of stock, but this is too outrageous!
Qing Mo put hundreds of millions of things in the space ring and came out.
He also threw a five-million-year-old colored scale fruit to Dabai.
Dabai was so happy that he almost couldn't take a breath and passed away.
Fortunately, Qing Mo took the attitude of thinking about his employees and asked the heaven in this world to give him two big mouths, so he woke up and told him that the colorful scale fruit given to him was the lowest in the current year.
Generally just used as fertilizer.
Only then did Dabai realize that his young master was really inhumane. He had lived in this continent for nearly ten thousand years, and he had never heard of any medicinal materials that were more than two hundred thousand years old. Even the top sects in Zhongzhou only had medicinal materials that were only seventeen or eighty thousand years old, and they regarded them as the treasures of the sect.
When they were approaching Liangcheng, Qingmo made Dabai shrink to the size of a house cat, not to mention quite cute.
